newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, investors sidelined.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, investors sidelined.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended mixed on Friday, as local investors kept to the sidelines unable to find clues towards market direction, traders said.
Prices ranged from 60 yen lower to 20 yen higher, with the benchmark July 1998 contract ending unchanged at 13,120 yen per tonne. Volume was estimated at 38,598 lots.
Local investors were reluctant to trade actively, as the Chicago grain market is closed on Friday, traders said.
A sharp fall in yen-based the Tokyo precious metals market also discouraged investors from trading today, they said.
